'''Salto Zendar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] criminal who lived during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. Zendar and his three brothers attempted to kidnap a high-ranking [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. However, their assault went awry; two of brothers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the security forces, another one was apprehended, and Salto himself was forced to go to a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] to recuperate from his injuries. The Banking Clan placed an extremely high [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head, and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], including [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], hunted him down, finally tracking him to a hospital on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]], where the nurse [[Serra]] determined Zendar was not fit to be moved until stabilized. There, they attacked him, and during the [[Skirmish in the Bandomeer hospital|ensuing skirmish]], he was counted among the victims.
